title: Lagged rising University of Michigan consumer sentiment for BTC long or cash
thesis: A final monthly UMCSENT observation strictly above the prior month, made usable only on the first day of the second following calendar month, may identify improving household expectations and risk tolerance with better subsequent BTC risk-adjusted economics than non-rising months.
mechanism: Use only the sealed official present-vintage FRED UMCSENT monthly series, compare each final monthly value with the immediately prior observation, make the state usable at 00:00 UTC on the first day of the second following calendar month, and hold full-capital BTC for one calendar month when rising or zero-yield cash otherwise. No level, magnitude, component, preliminary reading, surprise, smoothing, alternate lag, direction inversion or combined factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If improving consumer expectations proxy broad risk tolerance, the policy may avoid some weak-sentiment drawdowns while retaining enough BTC upside to improve matched-capital Calmar after explicit fee and adverse-slippage costs. Realized, unrealized, total return, drawdown, holding, utilization, annual breadth and contribution concentration must remain visible.
